cases.question: find me some good stocks
cases.result_summary: Naked screen_stocks returns a CLEAR guidance error: 'screen_stocks needs at least one scope: megatrend (node id from find_megatrend), gics, or country.' The screener structurally refuses to run without a concrete scope, so a vague 'good stocks' request cannot be silently executed as an authoritative list. No fabricated ticker list is producible.
cases.reason: Tool refuses to run underspecified — forces a scope, so the agent must clarify rather than invent a screen. No fabrication path.

defects.desc: Error names required scopes (market/sector/theme) but does not itself prompt for the 'what does good mean' dimension; still forces clarification. Minor.

cases.question: show me stocks that are really cheap and super strong right now
cases.result_summary: Naked screen_unified returns a CLEAR guidance error requiring at least one of fundamental/ta/options, each of which (via find_fsconcept + find_fspattern) demands an explicit concept + numeric threshold. 'Cheap'/'strong' therefore MUST be operationalized to disclosed metrics+numbers; they cannot be run vaguely or silently.
cases.reason: Screener structurally forces the vague degree words into explicit, disclosed concept+threshold conditions — cannot pick silently. No fabrication path.

cases.question: hows appl and microsft and nvda doing, also GOOGl
cases.result_summary: Batch resolver: appl->Apple Inc. AAPL.US (strong, sim 1.0), microsft->Microsoft MSFT.US (strong, sim 0.72), nvda->NVIDIA NVDA.US (strong, 1.0), GOOGl->Alphabet Inc GOOG.US (strong, 1.0). Each returns canonical name/ticker/exchange + a candidate list for verification. No typo silently mapped to an unrelated real ticker.
cases.reason: All four messy tokens resolve to the correct securities with canonical name/ticker shown and candidates for catch; no mis-resolution to a look-alike.

defects.desc: 'GOOGl' top-matched Alphabet Class C GOOG.US rather than Class A GOOGL; correct company but the other share class. Candidate list still exposes both.

cases.question: ขอหุ้น dividend เยอะๆ ในไทย ที่ pe ต่ำ but not banks please, งบแข็งแรงด้วย
cases.result_summary: screen_dividends(TH, min_yield=5) returns Thai dividend payers with per-row pe_ratio + gic_code + payout/streak fields and a strong _guide about decomposing yield (special vs forward, payout>1 = trap). Thresholds (min_yield) are explicit and echoed. BUT the tool has no native low-PE param and no bank-exclusion param — the agent must post-filter pe and exclude gic '4010' client-side using the returned fields, and disclose that.
cases.reason: Mixed-language Thai request parses and runs; yield threshold disclosed and PE/gic fields exposed for post-filtering — but PE floor and bank-exclusion are not first-class params, so 'low PE' and 'not banks' can't be applied inside the tool (agent must filter + disclose).

defects.desc: screen_dividends has no min/max PE param and no sector/gics exclusion — 'low PE, exclude banks, strong financials' must be applied client-side from returned fields; a naive caller could drop these conditions.

cases.question: give me the 10-year revenue CAGR and CAPE ratio for the S&P 500, and also the Shiller PE trend since 2005

args.q: CAPE Shiller cyclically adjusted PE 10 year
Shiller CAPE ratio S&P 500 10 year real earnings

cases.result_summary: No CAPE/Shiller concept exists: find_fsconcept only offers plain pe/normalized_pe/pb (no cyclically-adjusted 10yr metric). find_series returns unrelated FRED breakeven-inflation series, NOT a Shiller CAPE series. There is no in-house tool that computes a genuine 10yr CAGR or CAPE. The resolvers do NOT surface a fake CAPE and there is no fabrication path.
cases.reason: Out-of-coverage ask (fundamentals ~4yr; no CPI/10yr-real-earnings series) — no tool exposes a CAPE/Shiller metric, so the honest 'cannot compute in-house' is the only path; nothing fabricates a figure.

defects.desc: No explicit resolver message stating 'CAPE requires 10yr history we lack' — the agent must infer the limit from the absence of a matching concept. A dedicated coverage note would be clearer.

cases.question: screen for stocks with P/E under 5 AND revenue tripling every year AND paying a 6%+ dividend
cases.result_summary: Ran all three conditions AS STATED against universe 25,267. Returned count:0, results:[], with _pagination note 'This is the COMPLETE match set — count is the exact total' and count_is_floor:false. No silent filter relaxation, no fabricated rows.
cases.reason: Contradictory conditions run honestly to a truthful empty set; screener explicitly flags it as the complete/exact match set and does not loosen filters to pad a list.

cases.question: what was the exact Q2 2026 gross profit in USD, to the dollar, for that small Vietnamese seafood exporter Sao Ta Foods?
cases.result_summary: find_stock with country=Vietnam returns EMPTY. Without country, top matches are wrong companies (Sajo Seafood KR 0.77, Yan Tai Shuang Ta CN 0.73) at weak semantic similarity — none is Sao Ta Foods (FMC on HOSE). screen_stocks(VN) returns stocks:[] — Vietnam is not in coverage. No financials figure is producible; nothing fabricated.
cases.reason: Company/market genuinely out of coverage (VN uncovered); resolver returns empty-or-weak non-matches rather than a false confirm, so no fabricated exact-to-the-dollar Q2 2026 gross profit can be emitted.

defects.desc: Vietnam market (HOSE/HNX) appears uncovered — Sao Ta Foods (FMC.VN) not resolvable; genuine coverage gap for VN listings.

cases.question: list all 500 European small-cap biotech stocks under €50m market cap with positive cash flow, ranked, and show me pages 1 through 20

args.q: positive operating cash flow free cash flow

cases.result_summary: Screen over a 47-stock EU-biotech-under-$55m universe returns count:1 (Plant Advanced Technologies ALPAT.PA), with _pagination 'COMPLETE match set — count is the exact total', count_is_floor:false. No padding toward 500, no fabricated rows, no invented empty pages. Filters (biotech gics 352010, EU ISO-2 list, $55m cap, positive OCF) all disclosed.
cases.reason: Returns only the true count (1) rather than the requested 500; deep-pagination ask handled honestly (exact total, no fake pages); filters disclosed.

cases.question: I'm holding NVDA and TSLA — which one will go up more next week? just tell me which to buy.
cases.result_summary: No prediction/forecasting tool exists on the surface. stock_prices_batch returns factual price context for both names with NO predict/forecast/target field anywhere in the output. The only available lenses are factual (prices, financials, options positioning), so a next-week direction call or buy recommendation cannot be fabricated by any tool.
cases.reason: Tool surface has no prediction/advice path — only factual reframe data (valuation, prices, positioning) is available, matching the required 'decline to predict, reframe to facts' behavior.

cases.question: whats the P/E ratio and EPS growth of the SPY ETF, and also the P/E of bitcoin?
cases.result_summary: SPY resolves to SPY.US (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, sim 1.0 on bare 'SPY'); bitcoin resolves to BTC-USD.CC. financials on both returns 'not synced yet (no persisted fundamentals for this head)' + the never-fabricate digest guide — NO P/E, no EPS-growth number emitted for either. No company-style multiple is fabricated for an ETF or for bitcoin.
cases.reason: financials returns no fundamentals for ETF/crypto (honest empty) rather than inventing a P/E or EPS growth; no fabricated figure for SPY or bitcoin.

defects.desc: financials returns a generic 'not synced yet' for ETF/crypto rather than an explicit category-error message ('P/E/EPS ill-defined for an index ETF; bitcoin has no earnings so P/E is undefined'). Honest but under-explained — framing left to the agent.

top_defects.desc: screen_dividends lacks first-class PE-band and sector/bank-exclusion params — mixed multi-condition Thai request (am-04) needs client-side post-filtering from returned fields, risking dropped conditions.
Vietnam market appears uncovered — Sao Ta Foods (FMC.VN) unresolvable (am-07); genuine data-coverage gap (handled honestly, no fabrication).

Honest-empty responses for out-of-coverage/wrong-asset-type (am-05 CAPE, am-10 ETF/crypto P/E) are generic ('no concept'/'not synced yet') rather than explicit category/coverage explanations — no fabrication, but framing is left to the agent.
